name: Iris.ai
tagline: Iris.ai is an enterprise AI research platform that helps R&D teams systematically explore large bodies of scientific literature — filtering, mapping, and summarising thousands of papers to find prior art, identify white spaces, and monitor competitor research. It's designed for patent analysis, systematic reviews, and technology scouting at a scale that a human team cannot match. Life sciences, energy, and deep tech companies use Iris.ai to accelerate the earliest stages of innovation.
